string.text: Threaded barrel
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting an appropriate suppressor.
Rebored barrel
Barrel with a faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity and reduces bullet dispersion.
Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Improved feeding mechanism
Individual adjustment of the standard parts of the feeding mechanism decreases the probability of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Improved ejector
Reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm. Improves reliability.
Tactical combo device
Combines the functions of narrow beam tactical flashlight and laser sight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Anatomical grips
Grip panels custom-made to fit the shooter's preferences. New panels allow for better grip and more comfortable shooting.
Lightweight grip
Slightly reduces overall weight of the firearm. A trifle, but as we know, it's the little thing that make up all the comfort.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the weapon parts significantly reduces wear.
Rail mount
Rail mount enables installation of additional tactical accessories.
Match trigger
Reduces felt recoil, which positively affects accuracy.
Lightweight magazine
maintenance magazine slightly reduces overall weight of the firearm.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts without any significant loss in other performance characteristics.
Chamber adjustment
Improves obturation by removing play in the chamber, which in turn increases muzzle velocity.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Trigger tuning
Reconfiguration of the trigger assembly with improvement of various parts gives a crisp break with a shorter, smoother trigger take-up, leading to faster follow-up shots.
Balanced slide
Decreases muzzle climb and felt recoil.
Lightweight frame
maintenance frame reduces the firearm's weight, without any loss in durability or other characteristics.
Recoil reduction system
Completely overhauled trigger group significantly decreases felt recoil.
